Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Ruling E: 1.x full film-model wire/terminal capability; separate from the initial mapping exchange preview.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

CODE RED V1 WIRE AND VIEW LOWERING. Begins after D1B and the current output-authority repair. It versions the heterogeneous source and full alignment proof into machine-readable and renderer-neutral packets.

Exact paths:
- codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/core.scala
- codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/story.scala
- codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/align.scala

- view/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/view/atlas.scala

- view/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/view/OutputSuite.scala
- view/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/viewprobe/OutputConstructionProbeSuite.scala

Required result: versioned codecs round-trip SourceBundle, axes, EvidenceSupport, StoryModel source envelope, checked nomination bundle, HsmmResult P and F, exact movie intervals, external states, missingness and recursively verified trace records. Legacy text JSON either decodes through an explicit migration or refuses with a typed version error; missing and empty never collapse. View lowering derives AdmittedViewBasis and report identities from issued source, recall, build, candidate and alignment receipts, never caller labels. Packets expose one focused recall unit plus alternatives, incoming and outgoing flow, hierarchy and textual twin while retaining the complete underlying proof.

Courts: all current text goldens remain byte-stable where schema permits; film round-trip preserves axis and interval identity; reorder, dropped candidate, omitted zero flow, external-state rename, missing-to-zero, foreign receipt, target-ID collision, mixed view roots, forged checked profile and cached-unverified cost mutation refuse. A no-semantics source packet contains no semantic marks. Packet ordering and hashes are deterministic.

Gate: exact reference-scope output; codec and view JVM, JS and Native tests, compileAll and scalafmtCheckAll; golden migration and refusal fixtures; exact output authority courts; independent type, numerical and accessibility-oriented packet review. No HTML browser claim, calibration default, provider or video byte.
set.title: [later] V1 codec and renderer-neutral lowering for movie recall P F artifacts
